caption: The drawing features a landscape scene with a ruined stone building on the left side, which has an arched doorway and partially standing walls rendered in shades of light gray with reddish-brown detailing. In the background, there are dark green trees, one tall and the rest more rounded, that extend across the scene along with hilly landmasses painted in dark blue-green and brown. A large body of water, depicted in light blue with white reflections, runs through the midsection of the scene behind the cows and in front of the distant hills. On the right side of the foreground, three cows in white and reddish-brown colors are shown grazing or lying on the green and blue banks of the water. The drawing is enclosed at the bottom by a horizontal yellow band with white floral patterns. The sky above is a solid medium blue without clouds. The lower part of the page around the image is uncolored and includes some light sketched lines and a faintly drawn rectangular shape on the right side.
title: Bandbox Design
